3643 oligoreo {ol-ig-o-reh'-o}

源於 3641 和 ora ("介意, 在乎") 的複合字; 動詞

欽定本 - despise 1; 1

1) (對事情) 不是很在乎, 輕看, 不太在意 (#來 12:5|)

from a compound of 3641 and ora ("care");; v

AV - despise 1; 1

1) to care little for, regard lightly, make small account
